sections.heading: PRIVACY
lead: This part tells you what PROXYZ collects, why, and what you can ask us to do about it. We aim for a short, honest policy instead of a long one written for lawyers.

parts.heading: Who we are
text: PROXYZ is a venture studio based in Phuket, Thailand. It is run by PROXYZ STUDIO CO., LTD. You can reach us at hello@proxyz.studio.

parts.heading: What we collect
text: This site has no forms, sets no cookies and runs no tracking. We do not use analytics that profiles individual visitors. We do not place advertising pixels. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for marketing.
If you write to us, we get your name, your email address and the contents of your message.
Like any website, the company that hosts ours (Vercel) handles technical data, such as your internet address, when your browser asks for a page. We do not use it to identify you.

parts.heading: Earlier visitors
text: If you gave us your details through an earlier version of this site, for example to book a call, this policy covers them too. They stay in our work email and our internal records.

parts.heading: Why we collect it
text: To reply to you. Nothing else.

parts.heading: How long we keep it
text: Until you ask us to delete it, or until there is no reason to keep it. Whichever comes first.

parts.heading: Where it lives
text: Email and message content stays in our work email (Google Workspace). We do not export your data outside these systems without telling you.

parts.heading: Your rights under Thailand's PDPA
text: Under the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562, you can:
list: Ask what personal data we hold about you.
Ask us to correct it if it is wrong.
Withdraw consent to processing at any time.
Lodge a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Committee of Thailand.
after: To exercise any of these, email hello@proxyz.studio. We respond within 30 days.

parts.heading: Children
text: This site is not aimed at children. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18. If you believe a minor has sent us personal data, write to us and we will delete it.

parts.heading: Changes to this policy
text: We can update this page. The date at the top tells you when it was last changed. If a change is material we will mark it on this page for at least 30 days.

sections.heading: TERMS
lead: These terms cover use of proxyz.studio.

parts.heading: Using the site
text: You can read the site and share links to it freely.

parts.heading: Content ownership
text: All copy, design, code, pictures and visual identity on proxyz.studio are owned by PROXYZ STUDIO CO., LTD. unless explicitly credited otherwise. You may not republish substantial portions of the content as your own.

parts.heading: No warranty
text: The site is provided as-is. We do our best to keep it accurate and available, but we cannot promise it is always either. Use what you find here at your own discretion.

parts.heading: Limitation of liability
text: PROXYZ STUDIO CO., LTD. is not liable for damages arising from your use of the site, except where Thai law does not permit such limitation.

parts.heading: Jurisdiction
text: These terms are governed by the laws of Thailand. Any dispute that cannot be resolved by discussion is handled in the courts of Bangkok.

parts.heading: Changes
text: We can update these terms. The date at the top tells you when. If a change is material we will mark it on this page for at least 30 days. Continuing to use the site after a change means you accept the updated version.
